hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Bottom adapter (hands-free connector)
function: The connector at the bottom of the CT stack that lands over the tree top adapter and latches without anyone on the tree.

tabs.overview: Funnel skirt, latch collar, and a flanged spool to the BOP; the same family of connector as the wireline stack uses.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the stack; latch profile matched to the tree adapter.
tabs.safety: Latch confirmed and tested before the swab valve is opened.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
